# Kitchen Renovation Costs Vancouver 2026: Real Price Breakdown

The question every Vancouver homeowner asks before signing a renovation contract is: how much does a kitchen renovation actually cost? The honest answer in 2026 is $25,000 to $200,000 depending on scope — and the difference between a $35,000 kitchen and an $80,000 kitchen is rarely what you think.

## 2026 Cost Ranges by Scope

| Scope | Low | Mid | High |
|-------|-----|-----|------|
| Cosmetic refresh (doors, hardware, paint) | $8,000 | $15,000 | $25,000 |
| Partial remodel (new cabinets, countertops, flooring) | $25,000 | $45,000 | $65,000 |
| Full gut renovation (all new cabinets, appliances, layout) | $65,000 | $95,000 | $150,000 |
| Luxury custom (structural changes, island, premium appliances) | $120,000 | $160,000 | $200,000+ |

All prices in CAD, materials and labour included, excluding GST.

## What Drives the Cost

**Cabinetry is the single largest line item — and the biggest variable.** Custom solid-wood cabinets run $800–$2,200 per linear foot of base and wall cabinets combined. A typical 10×10 Vancouver kitchen (100 sq ft) with custom cabinets sits at $25,000–$45,000 just for cabinets before countertops or appliances. IKEA or other modular cabinetry runs $200–$500/linear foot but requires careful measurement and skilled assembly.

**Countertops determine both budget and timeline.** Quartz (the dominant choice in Vancouver) runs $65–$150 per square foot installed. A typical 30-square-foot quartz countertop costs $2,000–$4,500 installed. Granite is $80–$200/sq ft. Marble runs $90–$250/sq ft but requires more maintenance. Porcelain slab is emerging at $80–$180/sq ft with better stain resistance than marble.

**Appliances are a budget shock for first-time renovators.** A built-in refrigerator ($4,000–$12,000), professional-grade range ($5,000–$15,000), range hood ($1,500–$5,000), and dishwasher ($1,000–$3,500) add $12,000–$35,000 before you touch a single wall. Budget-conscious reno clients at Reno Stars typically spend $8,000–$18,000 on appliances.

**Structural changes multiply cost fast.** Moving a sink or stove to a different wall requires re-routing plumbing and gas lines — adding $3,000–$8,000 per moved fixture. Knocking down a non-load-bearing wall to open the kitchen to a living room adds $5,000–$15,000 for the wall work, rewiring, and potential HVAC adjustments.

**Electrical and lighting.** Vancouver kitchens built before 1990 often need a full electrical panel upgrade to handle modern loads. Budget $2,500–$7,500 for a sub-panel. Under-cabinet LED lighting runs $800–$2,500. Pot filler faucets, wine fridges, and built-in coffee systems each add $500–$3,000.

## Cost Per Square Foot

| Finish Level | $/sq ft |
|------------|---------|
| Basic refresh | $100–$150 |
| Mid-range remodel | $150–$300 |
| Full custom gut | $300–$550 |
| Luxury custom | $550–$850+ |

For a typical 150 sq ft Vancouver kitchen: $22,500–$82,500 for mid-range, $82,500–$130,000 for full custom.

## What Is Included at Each Level

**Cosmetic refresh ($8K–$25K):** Cabinet door and drawer front replacement, new hardware (handles, hinges), wall painting, updated light fixtures, new faucet, potentially new sink.

**Partial remodel ($25K–$65K):** Everything in cosmetic refresh, plus new laminate or quartz countertops, new resilient flooring (LVP or tile), new range hood, new dishwasher, perhaps a new electric cooktop.

**Full gut renovation ($65K–$150K):** All new custom or semi-custom cabinets, quartz or granite countertops, new stainless steel appliance package, porcelain or hardwood flooring, complete electrical rewiring, new plumbing for sink and dishwasher, pot filler faucet, under-cabinet lighting, new recessed lighting.

**Luxury custom ($120K–$200K+):** Custom solid-wood inset cabinets, premium stone or porcelain slab countertops, professional-grade appliance suite (48-inch range, built-in refrigerator, warming drawer), structural modifications, walk-in pantry, island with waterfall countertop, premium lighting design, heated floors.

## Hidden Costs Most Vancouver Renovations Hit

**Asbestos in pre-1990 homes.** Approximately 60% of Vancouver homes built before 1990 contain asbestos in the floor tiles, linoleum backing, or pipe wrap. Testing costs $300–$800. Abatement runs $2,000–$18,000 depending on scope. This must be done before any demo.

**Plumbing surprises in character homes.** Vancouver special houses often have galvanized steel pipes that corrode internally. When cabinets come out, you sometimes find pipes that need immediate replacement. Budget $2,000–$8,000 for unexpected plumbing remediation.

**Strata and permit requirements for multi-family buildings.** If you own a condo or townhouse with a strata, kitchen renovations that alter plumbing, electrical, or structural elements require written strata approval before the city will issue a permit. Strata approval adds 4–8 weeks in most Vancouver condo buildings.

**Appliance lead times.** As of 2026, premium appliances (Sub-Zero, Wolf, Miele) have 8–16 week lead times. Order appliances at the estimate stage, not after demo. Reno Stars includes appliance procurement in the project timeline from day one.

## How Long Does a Kitchen Renovation Take in Vancouver?

| Scope | Duration |
|-------|----------|
| Cosmetic refresh | 2–4 weeks |
| Partial remodel | 4–6 weeks |
| Full gut renovation | 6–10 weeks |
| Luxury custom | 10–18 weeks |

Permit timelines in Vancouver: minor cosmetic work typically needs no permit; new circuits, gas line changes, and structural work require permits. Vancouver building permits for kitchen renovations run $500–$2,500 depending on scope, with 2–5 week approval timelines.

## ROI: Does a Kitchen Renovation Add Value in Vancouver?

Yes — strategically. A mid-range kitchen renovation in Vancouver recovers 70–85% of cost at resale according to Reno Stars project data across 58 completed projects. A high-end renovation in a West Vancouver or Dunbar home can recover 80–100% and become a primary selling feature.

The worst ROI mistake in Vancouver: overspending on a premium kitchen in a neighbourhood of original-1970s homes. Match your renovation level to the street.

## Choosing a Vancouver Kitchen Contractor

The spread between the cheapest and most expensive Vancouver kitchen renovation quotes is typically $30,000–$60,000 on mid-range projects. Here is what separates the contractors worth hiring from those who are not:

- Detailed line-item quotes, not lump sums
- $5 million commercial general liability insurance
- Active WorkSafeBC clearance letter
- References from at least 3 completed kitchen projects
- A dedicated project manager who is your single point of contact
- Written warranty (1 year minimum, 2–3 years is the quality standard)
- No mention of cash discounts or skipping permits — this is a red flag

## Free Estimate

Reno Stars provides no-obligation estimates for kitchen renovations across Metro Vancouver. Every quote is a detailed scope of work with material specifications, appliance recommendations, and a projected start date.

To get started: [reno-stars.com/en/contact](https://www.reno-stars.com/en/contact/) or call **778-960-7999**.

# 溫哥華廚房裝修費用2026：真實造價分析

每個溫哥華業主在簽訂裝修合同之前都會問的問題是：廚房裝修實際費用是多少？2026年誠實的答案是根據工程範圍從$25,000到$200,000不等——而且$35,000廚房和$80,000廚房之間的差異往往不是你想象的那樣。

## 2026年按工程範圍的費用區間

| 裝修範圍 | 最低 | 中等 | 最高 |
|---------|------|------|------|
| 裝飾性翻新（門板、五金、油漆） | $8,000 | $15,000 | $25,000 |
| 局部改造（新櫃檯面、水槽、櫥櫃、地板） | $25,000 | $45,000 | $65,000 |
| 全面拆建（全部新櫥櫃、設備、佈局） | $65,000 | $95,000 | $150,000 |
| 豪華定制（結構改造、中島島台、高端電器） | $120,000 | $160,000 | $200,000+ |

以上均為加元，包含材料和人工，不含GST。

## 哪些因素影響造價

**櫥櫃是最大的單一項目——也是最大的變數。** 定制實木櫥櫃每線性英尺（底櫃和牆櫃合計）造價$800至$2,200。一個典型的10×10溫哥華廚房（100平方英尺）配定制櫥櫃，僅櫥櫃就需$25,000至$45,000，還不含檯面或電器。IKEA或其他模塊化櫥櫃每線性英尺$200至$500，但需要精確測量和熟練組裝。

**檯面決定預算和時間線。** 石英石（溫哥華的主流選擇）每平方英尺安裝費用為$65至$150。一個典型30平方英尺的石英石檯面，安裝費用為$2,000至$4,500。花崗岩為$80至$200/平方英尺。大理石為$90至$250/平方英尺，但需要更多保養。瓷板正在興起，價格為$80至$180/平方英尺，比大理石更好的抗污能力。

**電器是第一次裝修者的預算衝擊。** 內置冰箱（$4,000至$12,000）、專業級燃氣灶（$5,000至$15,000）、抽油煙機（$1,500至$5,000）和洗碗機（$1,000至$3,500），在動一面牆之前就已經增加了$12,000至$35,000。Reno Stars的節省型裝修客戶通常在電器上花費$8,000至$18,000。

**結構改造快速增加成本。** 將水槽或爐灶移到不同的牆壁需要重新鋪設管道和燃氣管線——每個移動的裝置額外增加$3,000至$8,000。拆除一面非承重牆以將廚房與客廳打通，需要$5,000至$15,000的牆體工程、布線和潛在的暖通調整費用。

**電力和照明。** 1990年以前建造的溫哥華廚房通常需要升級配電箱以滿足現代負載。子配電箱預算為$2,500至$7,500。櫥櫃下LED照明費用為$800至$2,500。飲用水龍頭、酒冰箱和嵌入式咖啡機每項增加$500至$3,000。

## 每平方英尺造價

| 裝修檔次 | 每平方英尺加元 |
|---------|-------------|
| 基本裝飾性翻新 | $100–$150 |
| 中檔局部改造 | $150–$300 |
| 全面定制拆建 | $300–$550 |
| 豪華定制 | $550–$850+ |

以典型150平方英尺溫哥華廚房為例：中檔翻新為$22,500至$82,500；全面定制為$82,500至$130,000。

## 各檔次包含的內容

**裝飾性翻新（$8K–$25K）：** 更換櫃門和抽屜面板、全新五金配件（把手、鉸鏈）、牆面油漆、更新照明燈具、全新水龍頭、可能更換水槽。

**局部改造（$25K–$65K）：** 包含裝飾性翻新所有項目，加上新 laminate 或石英石檯面、新彈性地板（LVP或瓷磚）、新抽油煙機、新洗碗機、可能新增電陶爐。

**全面拆建（$65K–$150K）：** 全部新定制或半定制櫥櫃、石英石或花崗岩檯面、全新不銹鋼電器套餐、瓷磚或實木地板、完整電路重新布線、水槽和洗碗機的新管道、飲用水龍頭、櫥櫃下照明、嵌入式照明。

**豪華定制（$120K–$200K+）：** 定制實木鑲嵌櫥櫃、優質石材或瓷板檯面、專業級電器套餐（48英寸爐灶、內置冰箱、保溫抽屜）、結構改造、步入式食品儲藏室、帶瀑布檯面的中島、優質照明設計、地暖。

## 溫哥華大多數裝修項目會遇到的隱藏費用

**1990年前房屋的石棉問題。** 約60%的1990年前建造的溫哥華房屋在地板瓷磚、油氈襯背或管道保溫層中含有石棉。測試費用為$300至$800。處理費用根據範圍為$2,000至$18,000。這必須在拆除之前完成。

**特色住宅的管道意外。** 溫哥華的特色住宅通常有鍍鋅鋼管，內部會腐蝕。當櫥櫃拆除後，有時會發現需要立即更換的管道。為意外的管道修復預算$2,000至$8,000。

**多戶型建築的HOA或許可證要求。** 如果您擁有共有所有權公寓或聯排別墅，任何改變管道、電氣或結構元素的廚房裝修都需要在市政府發放許可證之前獲得HOA書面批准。在大多數溫哥華公寓樓中，HOA批准需要額外4至8週時間。

**電器交付前置時間。** 截至2026年，高端電器（Sub-Zero、Wolf、Miele）的交付前置時間為8至16週。在估價階段就應該訂購電器，而不是拆除之後。Reno Stars從第一天起就將電器採購納入項目時間表。

## 溫哥華廚房裝修需要多長時間

| 裝修範圍 | 施工時間 |
|---------|---------|
| 裝飾性翻新 | 2–4週 |
| 局部改造 | 4–6週 |
| 全面拆建 | 6–10週 |
| 豪華定制 | 10–18週 |

溫哥華許可證時間線：輕微裝飾性工程通常不需要許可證；新電路、燃氣管線改動和結構工程需要許可證。溫哥華廚房裝修建築許可證費用根據工程範圍為$500至$2,500，批准時間為2至5週。

## 回報率：溫哥華廚房裝修能否增加房產價值

是的——而且是有策略的。根據Reno Stars在58個已完成項目中的數據，溫哥華中檔廚房裝修在轉售時可回收70%至85%的成本。West Vancouver或Dunbar房屋的高端廚房裝修可回收80%至100%，成為主要銷售亮點。

溫哥華最糟糕的回報率錯誤：在一個均為1970年代原始房屋的社區中過度裝修高端廚房。讓您的裝修水平與樓盤相匹配。

## 選擇溫哥華廚房承包商

溫哥華廚房裝修報價中最低和最高之間的差距在中等項目上通常為$30,000至$60,000。以下是區分值得聘用的承包商和不值得雇用的承包商的標準：

- 詳細的逐項報價，而非總價
- $500萬商業一般責任保險
- 有效的WorkSafeBC清除信
- 至少3個已完成廚房項目的參考資料
- 一位作為您單一聯繫人的專用項目經理
- 書面保修（最低1年，2至3年為優質標準）
- 不提及現金折扣或跳過許可證——這是一個危險信號

## 免費估價

Reno Stars為Metro Vancouver的廚房裝修提供免費、無承諾的估價。每份報價都是一份詳細的工程範圍，包含材料規格、電器建議和預計開工日期。

開始工作： [reno-stars.com/en/contact](https://www.reno-stars.com/en/contact/) 或致電 **778-960-7999**。
